Photo 1 shows the same machine from a different angle, still wrapped in plastic. The machine has a beige front panel and a black top section. The '224e' model is visible again.
The machine appears to be a large office printer or copier, possibly a laser printer, given the 'Test Page' and '224e' model name.
The plastic wrapping suggests it is new or unused, but the machine is not fully visible, and no power cord or control panel is shown.

No photo shows the printer in operation or any speed test. The claim cannot be verified from still images.
No photo shows the printer's internal components or any label indicating resolution. The claim cannot be verified from still images.
